name: logAllThreads
description: Writes stack traces of all running threads to a JSON Lines file at a set interval for a set time, to help find performance problems. Runs in the background and returns right away.

params.name: path
params.description: The file to write to, ideally ending in `.jsonl`. The file is created or appended to.

params.name: interval
params.description: The time between captures, in milliseconds.

params.name: duration
params.description: How long to capture for, in milliseconds.
